system.description:
Requirements: You must receive training from a White Fox or another follower of the Path of the White Fox, or have access to their teachings

White Foxes are among the most capricious of sacred beasts with an innate connection to fate. You have learned some of their tricks, granting you a portion of their cunning and wisdom.

  • Select 1 Path Ability with the White Fox trait. You immediately gain that Ability without the associated XP cost.

  • You can see in the dark as easily as in the day, though magical darkness may still confound you.

rulesElement.message: Path of the White Fox: You can see in the dark as easily as in the day, though magical darkness may still confound you.
